title: RUN OVER CARD: SCORE LABEL, DIM ZERO, WARN PENALTY, INSET RULE
why: The critic scored the run over card 3 after v31.73 and the board 2: the hero is one flat line with the score word as big as the figure, a zero score shines at full brightness, the footer rule runs wider than the stats rule above it, the penalty has no warning colour, and the empty line is centred while every row is left. Restyle only: the text is the same.
now: The run over card has a small score label over the big figure, a zero score is dim, the penalty is amber, and the rules line up.

edits.anchor: body #attract .arcpage, body #attract .arcover{ background-image:linear-gradient(var(--ui-line), var(--ui-line)); background-repeat:no-repeat; background-size:calc(100% - var(--sp-5) * var(--attz,1)) 1px; background-position:center calc(100% - (var(--sp-3) + var(--btn-h) + var(--sp-2)) * var(--attz,1)); }
for(i=0;i<ln.length;i++){ if(!ln[i][1]) continue; el=document.createElement('div'); el.className=ln[i][0]; el.textContent=ln[i][1]; c.appendChild(el); }
